title: Quasianalyticity and geometric rigidity in anisotropic Calderón's problem
summary: The anisotropic Calderón problem of determining a smooth Riemannian metric from boundary measurements, up to a boundary-fixing diffeomorphism, remains open in dimensions $n\ge3$~\cite{uhlmann2009electrical}. We establish unique identifiability results in two complementary regimes.
